The Rio most people miss is the one we call home.

Rainforest trails, granite summits and the stories in between, guided by people who love this city from the ground up.

Our story

Itaway Ecotours was founded in 2018 by two best friends who shared a deep love for Rio de Janeiro’s natural beauty and its rich cultural heritage.

Too many travelers see Rio from a beach towel and a cable car, then fly home without knowing that a rainforest grows right through the middle of the city.

Without hearing a waterfall ten minutes from a traffic jam. Without standing on granite older than the streets below and understanding what the view is really saying.

So they set out to show the rest.

Itaway

Itaway, from Tupi: stone.

In Tupi, Itaway means stone.

The ground that holds when everything else moves. It is how we guide: steady on the trail, rooted in the land, and connected to the peoples who named these mountains long before the city had a name.

Strength.Stability.Connection.

Rio, beyond the shoreline.

Nature and culture live side by side here. Our tours are designed to walk you through both.

A rainforest inside the city

Tijuca Forest is loud with birdsong, marmosets and the occasional sloth, and it starts where the neighborhoods end.

Waterfalls and hidden caves

Trails that end where the water begins, with cool pools and caves where the city goes completely quiet.

Granite summits

Pedra da Gávea, Pedra Bonita, Pico da Tijuca. The city looks different from up here, and so do you.

Culture along the trail

Indigenous history, samba rhythms and neighborhoods full of life. Every path comes with its story.

Our guides know every trail. More importantly, they know why it matters.

We don’t measure a tour by the summit. We measure it by the moment you stop talking, look out over the city, and understand exactly where you are.
